reason: I would ask my family WhatsApp group before I spend on my car, and a new app with partners only just being added in Riyadh and Cairo is not something they can vouch for yet. Without a recommendation from someone I know, I would not hand over that much money to a site I have never used.
objection: How do I know the film is genuine and the warranty is honoured if something goes wrong? Checking ID and commercial registration tells me the partner exists, not that they will install proper film or answer me when there is a problem.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or family member who has used a partner through ArmorHub, got genuine film, and had the warranty honoured when they needed it.
